    12	For an affine scheme `X`, this file assembles the Picard classes of unit Čech cocycles

    14	group homomorphism

    16	* `AlgebraicGeometry.Scheme.CechPic.toPic : X.CechPic →* CommRing.Pic Γ(X, ⊤)`

    19	sections.  (Surjectivity — hence the full dictionary `X.CechPic ≃* CommRing.Pic Γ(X, ⊤)`
    20	— is the invertible-module-trivialization direction, treated separately.)
    21	
    22	The core is the **independence of the descent Picard class from every choice**
    23	(`BasicRefinement.pic_congr`): representing cocycle of the `H¹` class, basic refinement,
    24	and pointed cover.  All comparisons are routed through three elementary moves:
    25	
    26	* `pic_res` — replacing the pointed cover by a finer one and restricting the cocycle

    19	  `R`-linear threading lemma**: the base-change equivalence carries `1 ⊗ r` to the
